generate_clozes_from_paragraph: generate cloze questions from a paragraph using noun phrase or named entity answer generators
mask_answer: mask an answer text in a sentence with a cloze mask placeholder based on answer type
is_appropriate_cloze: test whether a sentence meets length, word size, and link-free criteria for a valid cloze
is_appropriate_answer: test whether an answer text meets minimum and maximum character and word length thresholds
is_appropriate_squad_datapoint: test whether a question, answer, and paragraph pair meets all SQuAD data quality thresholds
